subject: Request: Deep Hosted API concession for HealTech strategic commit
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HealTech request - need deal desk + exec escalation

Ben —

Quick summary: HealTech (Emma Jensen, VP Product) just sent final usage forecasts and wants a hosted API rate >20% below our published published volume tiers. They are proposing an 18‑month, 60M token/month ramp commitment (see attached forecast). They asked for a single-line concession so procurement can sign this quarter.

Why this matters: they are a strategic reference in inpatient AI workflows and want multi-region deployment (US + EU). If we provide a deep concession now we likely secure a long-term case study and a potential marketplace listing next year.

What I need: deal desk recommended a concession, but Ben — can you run the unit economics and flag whether this is approvable at <senior> level? If we need >20% please escalate to exec. I can take product/ops risk on quantization profile and can commit to a joint engineering kickoff.

Attachments: HealTech_Forecast_Q1-Q4_2027.xlsx, SOW_v3.docx

Next step: Ben — can you reply with recommended range and whether this requires executive approval? I will then loop Markus and request signoff timeline.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealTech request - need deal desk + exec escalation

Marissa —

Thanks for the materials. I ran the pricing workup (attached Pricing_Workup_DEAL-2026-451.pdf). Key takeaways:
- Baseline published tier rate: $0.0018/token (hosted API standard volume).
- HealTech proposed effective target: ~25% below published (target ~ $0.00135/token) driven by long commit and aggressive ramp.
- With their forecast (60M tokens/mo steady-state by month 6) the 18-month committed ARR looks attractive, but the near-term burn on reserved capacity and quota enforcement risk is non-trivial.

Recommendation: Approve a structured concession rather than a flat, permanent list price cut. I recommend: 25% concession on hosted API unit rate for 18 months with standard usage floors, stipulation that any overage revert to published rates, and a 9‑month public reference requirement. This should be treated as an exec-level exception because it exceeds our established 20% approval threshold.

If you want me to scope a fall-back (30% cap for first 3 months only) I can draft language for legal.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

--Attachment: Pricing_Workup_DEAL-2026-451.pdf--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: HealTech request - exec signoff needed for 25% concession

Markus — forwarding Ben's analysis and the forecast. Short ask: can you authorize an exec-level concession for this strategic trial if Mina signs off?

Proposed commercial guardrails I want included:
- 18‑month minimum commitment (with 6‑month ramp schedule tied to forecast)
- 25% off published hosted API rate for the committed term (then revert)
- Early termination fee (prorated to remaining commitment)
- Public reference + 1 joint case study within 12 months of go‑live
- Legal to include usage floors and audit rights

If you agree in principle I will loop procurement at HealTech and get countersigned SOW in parallel to DocuSign.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: Approval request — HealTech deep concession (25%)

Mina —

Need a quick executive decision on this strategic request. Summary below: 
- Customer: HealTech Health Systems (Emma Jensen, VP Product).
- Ask: 25% off hosted API list rates for 18 months in exchange for an 18‑month commit and 60M tokens/mo steady-state by month 6.
- Strategic value: reference account in inpatient product lines; potential marketplace listing; multi-region (US+EU) expansion.
- Risk: margin compression >20% threshold; potential capacity and on-call support during onboarding.

Ben attached a unit-economics workup (short summary: profitable at steady-state with the commit, but high short-term provisioning). Recommended guardrails included in the email thread.

Request: can you sign off on conditional exec approval (25%) subject to Legal & Finance adding early-termination protection + clear usage floors? If yes, please reply with any additional constraints you want included.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
VP, GTM | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

> On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 08:45 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request — HealTech deep concession (25%)

Markus/Team —

I reviewed Ben's workup and Marissa's win rationale. I'm prepared to approve a 25% hosted API concession for this account with explicit conditions: 
1) Commitment and term: 18‑month minimum with the forecasted ramp (60M tokens/mo by month 6).
2) Financial protections: enforce a monthly usage floor equal to 50% of forecast for months 1–6; overage billed at published list rates unless we elect to extend concession in writing. Early termination will incur a prorated make‑whole equal to the remaining committed value at the concession rate.
3) Product/operational: joint engineering kickoff within 30 days of signature and a dedicated onboarding playbook with SLOs. Customer pays for any expedited on-call support beyond standard onboarding windows.
4) Commercial: HealTech will provide a public reference and participate in a joint case study within 12 months; Redwood may publish aggregate usage metrics.
5) Legal/Compliance: procurement must sign DocuSign SOW with the above guardrails and an explicit audit clause.

If Legal flags anything, I'll re-review. This approval is conditional on final SOW reflecting items 1–5. Please loop Legal & Finance and prepare a short amendment to the SOW that we can send alongside DocuSign.

Approved (conditional).

Mina Haddad
SVP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
--Sent from mobile—apologies for brevity--

- Protections: monthly usage floors (50% of forecast months 1–6), early‑termination make‑whole, audit rights.
- Operational: joint eng kickoff within 30 days of countersignature; onboarding playbook and SLOs will be shared.
- PR: public reference and joint case study within 12 months required.

I have attached the SOW v3 (redlines pending) and the forecast. I also created a DocuSign envelope for signatures: https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/E-AB12CD34EF

Best —
